name: fact-emission
body: A frontend resolving against the full compilation context and emitting facts for its discovered projects/files — declarations, references, and edges — with anything unresolved emitted as an UnresolvedTarget, never guessed. Emission is per discovered project; the full context is never reduced. For Python, emission resolves against the full `ty` project (imports and base classes cross files) and uses the ty/salsa native incremental cache; only emission is filtered to the target set (requirements.requirement.python-incremental-contract).
